changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[DatabaseServer]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] ( [ID] int identity(1,1) NOT NULL, [Server] varchar(250) NOT NULL, [Username] varchar(25) NOT NULL, [Password] varchar(50) MASKED WITH (FUNCTION = 'default()') NOT NULL, [SearchServer] varchar(250) NULL, [IsDevelopment] bit CONSTRAINT [DF_DatabaseServer_IsDevelopment] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [EnvironmentLevel] int CONSTRAINT [DF_DatabaseServer_EnvironmentLevel] DEFAULT (-1) NOT NULL, [Notes] nvarchar(500) NULL, [Region] varchar(250) CONSTRAINT [DF_DatabaseServer_Region] DEFAULT ('<unknown>') NOT NULL, [RegionCode] char(2) CONSTRAINT [DF_DatabaseServer_RegionCode] DEFAULT ('US') NOT NULL, [ResourceGroup] varchar(250) NULL, [ElasticPools] varchar(2500) NULL, constraint [PK_DatabaseServer] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) end
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DatabaseServer' and COLUMN_NAME = 'EventTopic') begin alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] drop constraint [DF_DatabaseServer_EventTopic] --alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] drop column [EventTopic]; end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DatabaseServer' and COLUMN_NAME = 'RegionCode') begin alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] add [RegionCode] char(2) constraint [DF_DatabaseServer_RegionCode] default('US') NOT NULL; end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DatabaseServer' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ResourceGroup') begin alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] add [ResourceGroup] [varchar](250) NULL end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'DatabaseServer' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ElasticPools') begin alter table [dbo].[DatabaseServer] add [ElasticPools] [varchar](2500) NULL end
